resource_review.seven_fixed_shared_layouts: All independently agree with the author's stage extents and dynamic formula before actual pmax/static allocation. Recorded-weight pmax bounds are not universal input bounds.
resource_review.NVIDIA_register_limit_probe: Unmodified pinned CUDA13.0.96 occupancy function executed under native clang for SM90, six block sizes and reported registers1..192. Root independently reproduced all1152 rows and thresholds.
resource_review.important_correction: Per-SM-subpartition warp availability invalidates naive ceilings88 at352threads and112 at288threads. Conversely416threads can admit two blocks at72; per-CTA verification rounding does not impose64 here.
resource_review.new_compiled_resources: UNKNOWN; no source arrays, old attributes or CPU model establish actual new registers, local allocation or occupancy.
resource_review.header_handling: Primary header remains local and untracked because its notice restricts redistribution. Commit only source URL/hash, probe/results and findings; no header enters a candidate.

router_and_lifetime_review.coordinate_bijection: 256 CTAs, tile=cta/8 and piece=cta%8, two512-K stages per piece cover all32 router tiles and all128 K64 units exactly once. Original router stream layout,8MiB payload and512 copy pairs remain unchanged.
router_and_lifetime_review.counter_bug_found: Mixing old four-way and new eight-way launches with shared counters can leave residue4mod8 and falsely elect arrival4 as last.
router_and_lifetime_review.fixed_policy: Every FUSE specialization, including TOKR32 used during tuning, uses eight-way routing. Both ordinary and UV paths allocate32*8*32*8 FP32 partials and retain counters advancing by8 per complete call.
router_and_lifetime_review.counter_model: All40320 eight-arrival permutations and a32-bit wrap boundary pass the abstract publication-before-increment model. This is not a GPU memory-order proof.
router_and_lifetime_review.stage_allocation: Pooler12KiB weight payload is smaller than router16KiB. DeviceSST, host allocation and preparation geometry must all use the larger extent for FUSE, while transaction counts retain actual copied byte counts.
router_and_lifetime_review.ring_reuse: Keep every escape-warp handback, cbar wait and consumer named barrier before router and pooler scratch reuse. The proposed reduction scratch fits entirely inside the ring in all seven layouts.
router_and_lifetime_review.PDL: Preserve existing waits and trigger placement. The later route dependency must continue protecting UV statistics against reset until all pooler readers finish.
router_and_lifetime_review.progress: Non-last router contributors do not spin, so eight-way reduction itself does not require whole-grid residency. Two-block capacity is the performance hypothesis gate; the unchanged BND grid barrier has a separate correctness admission requirement.
router_and_lifetime_review.precision: Router partial grouping, escape grouping and separateT32 K-warp grouping change FP32 association. Retain all BF16/hi-lo operands and FP32 terms; no bit-equivalence claim.

mechanism_assessment.plausible_distinct_mechanism: Independent admitted half-row streams and compute warps for unchanged weight/MMA totals; fused pooler grid128to256 nearly fills two-block capacity, and MT1/NACC2 pooler accumulator state held through router falls32to16 FP32 words.
costs_not_hidden: Fused pooler main copy count and activation requests double; total stage pairs2560to4608. Router copy count stays512, while router partial stores/reads and atomic count increase.
Fused main-weight lookahead perSM decreases144to96KiB atTOKR8 and120to72KiB atTOKR16 despite more stage slots.
SeparateT32 pooler retains4096 weight copy pairs but doubles activation requests and changes K reduction from two to four warps.
QKV grid96to144 does not populate two blocks on every SM. It increases activation/copy requests50percent and can expose tail costs. Capacity alone does not predict a gain.
mechanism_assessment.performance_evidence: No measured parent stall bottleneck, no new compiler result and no speed forecast. That uncertainty does not by itself forbid one well-gated experiment.
mechanism_assessment.five_percent_decoder_threshold: Prioritization heuristic only, not a required gain or user constraint. A well-measured useful incremental gain can be worthwhile.

required_next_plan: Declare the isolated causal scope and exact config/dispatch/packing/buffer changes before implementation; no geometry sweep.
Prove all generated ordinary/FUSE/UV paths and ragged PK specializations use the intended stream and scratch schema, including tuner-only alternatives.
Use actual prepared pmax and exact function queries. PrimaryA8/A16/B32/C8/C16/C32 performance targets require at least two admitted blocks and clean resource evidence.

Uniform FUSE32 compatibility may admit one block with valid resources/local0 only if terminal timed profiles do not select it. This is an offline interpretation gate; candidate code must not detect timing phases.
Emit bounded resource evidence before any checked failure; legacy tuner exception handling can swallow an unsuccessful alternative, so privatePASS alone does not prove all resource gates.
CPU tests must execute actual packing/address/reduction code where possible, preserve unchanged source controls, and stress router generations, UV pairs, ragged physical M and ring lifetimes.
Require official numerical correctness and a declared measured promotion/kill criterion. Resource failure does not authorize forced quotas or nearby-parameter retries.
